dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you think is the most important element of a story?

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: The number of people in the protagonist's party.

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: The number of people in the protagonist's party.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's so important, you said it twice.

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: If we're talking about an epic, having a four-person party would be too few, but 108 would be a few too many.

dialogues.speaker: Okikuni
dialogues.text: In my opinion, eight is the perfect number.
